resources.string: Power the phone from the charger while holding the battery level
Stop charging immediately and run from the charger, holding the current battery level

Run the phone straight from the charger instead of charging the battery, so it isn\'t kept at a high charge while plugged in.
While bypass is active, the charger powers the phone and the battery stays at its level, which reduces heat and battery wear. Normal charging always returns when you unplug the charger.
Bypass starts when you plug in a charger
Plug in a charger to use bypass charging
Takes effect with the next battery update
